instructions.name: close_user_accounts
docs: Close consent + portfolio (all snapshots must be closed first).

accounts.name: risk_model
docs: Source of the governed oracle feed per asset.

instructions.name: set_oracle_feed
docs: Pyth feed id for an asset. Setting or switching a feed waits for the
timelock; clearing it (all zeros) applies at once.

accounts.name: user
docs: portfolio and snapshot PDA seeds.

accounts.name: venue_authority
docs: With `venue-cpi` (production) this is the venue program's
[b"clearinghouse"] PDA (enforced at registration), so only that program
can sign, through CPI. With `dev-venue-signer` it may be a keypair.

errors.name: VenueNotAuthorized
errors.msg: Venue not authorized in user consent

errors.name: PriceUncertain
errors.msg: Price oracle confidence interval too wide

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price cannot be zero or negative

errors.name: InvalidMargin
errors.msg: Margins must satisfy 0 < maintenance <= initial <= notional

errors.name: PortfolioFull
errors.msg: Portfolio already has the maximum number of legs

errors.name: IncompletePortfolio
errors.msg: Refresh must include exactly the portfolio's registered snapshots, then one oracle per leg

errors.name: SnapshotCloseNotAllowed
errors.msg: Caller may not close this snapshot

errors.name: InvalidRiskParams
errors.msg: Risk parameter outside its allowed bounds

errors.name: ChangeTooLarge
errors.msg: Change exceeds the per-update step limit

errors.name: VenueAuthorityNotProgramPda
errors.msg: Venue authority must be the venue program's [\clearinghouse\] PDA

errors.name: OracleNotFullyVerified
errors.msg: Pyth price update is not fully verified

errors.name: SnapshotsStillOpen
errors.msg: Close every position snapshot before closing the user's accounts

fields.name: move_bps
docs: Signed move in bps, in [-10_000, 10_000].

types.name: AssetRiskArgs
docs: Instruction argument form of `AssetRiskParams` (Borsh).

types.name: AssetRiskParams
docs: Per-asset stress parameters as stored. `shock_bps == 0` means unsupported:
refresh fails closed for any leg in that asset.

fields.name: max_venues
docs: Highest venue index + 1 that may be registered (<= 64).

fields.name: haircut_bps
docs: Safety haircut applied to the computed hedge benefit.

fields.name: credit_ttl_slots
docs: Credit lifetime in slots (1..=MAX_CREDIT_TTL_SLOTS).

fields.name: snapshot_max_age_slots
docs: A snapshot older than this cannot back credit.

fields.name: max_credit_per_user
docs: Cap on one portfolio's total credit (micro-USD).

fields.name: max_credit_bps_of_im
docs: Per-leg cap as a fraction of the leg's initial margin.

fields.name: max_credit_per_venue
docs: Cap on outstanding credit across all users, per venue (micro-USD).

fields.name: max_credit_per_asset
docs: Cap on outstanding credit across all users, per asset (micro-USD).

fields.name: global_credit_cap
docs: Protocol-wide cap on outstanding credit (micro-USD).

fields.name: risk_model_max_age_slots
docs: The risk model must have been updated within this many slots.

fields.name: max_move_bps
docs: Price move vs the portfolio's stored baseline that allows permissionless invalidation.

fields.name: timelock_slots
docs: Delay before a credit-increasing governance change or venue activation
takes effect (floor: governance::MIN_TIMELOCK_SLOTS).

fields.name: rho
docs: Scaled 1e6, in [-1e6, 1e6].

fields.name: admin
docs: Role management, unpause, admin transfer. Can be a multisig PDA.

fields.name: risk_authority
docs: Parameters, correlations, shocks, scenarios (bounded, timelocked).

fields.name: venue_manager
docs: Register, activate (timelocked) and deactivate venues.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Pause, emergency epoch bump, cancel pending changes, deactivate
venues: powers that can only reduce credit.

fields.name: risk_epoch
docs: Bumped by every parameter, risk-model and venue-lifecycle change and by
emergency invalidation. A portfolio is usable only while its epoch matches.

fields.name: used_venues_bitmap
docs: Indices ever assigned. Never cleared: an index is not reusable.

fields.name: active_venues_bitmap
docs: Indices of currently active venues (subset of `used_venues_bitmap`).

fields.name: global_outstanding_credit
docs: Outstanding credit counted in the current epoch. Reset on every epoch bump.

types.name: LegState
docs: The inputs a leg's credit was computed from, plus the credit itself.

fields.name: baseline_price
docs: Oracle price and confidence at computation time (the guard baseline, F5).

fields.name: baseline_publish_ts
docs: Oracle publish time of the baseline. Invalidation evidence must be
strictly newer, so an old (but genuine) update cannot trip credit.

types.name: PendingChange
docs: Singleton. Seeds: [SEED_PENDING_CHANGE].

types.name: Portfolio
docs: One per user. Seeds: [SEED_PORTFOLIO, user].

fields.name: credit_kind
docs: Credit semantics flag; always CREDIT_KIND_TRADING_POWER_ONLY.

fields.name: version
docs: Incremented on every computation and every invalidation.

fields.name: risk_epoch
docs: Config epoch / risk-model version the credit was computed under.

fields.name: counted
docs: True while `legs[*].credit` / `total_credit` are included in the
config's outstanding counters for epoch `counted_epoch`.

fields.name: num_registered
docs: Every (venue, asset) for which a snapshot account exists. A refresh
must include all of them.

fields.name: num_legs
docs: Legs as of the last computation.

types.name: PosSnapshot
docs: One position of one user on one venue in one asset, as reported by the venue.
Seeds: [SEED_SNAPSHOT, user, venue_id, [asset_id]].

fields.name: version
docs: Monotonic: 1 on creation, +1 on every write.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid rent; receives it back when the snapshot is closed.

types.name: RiskChange
docs: A credit-increasing governance change waiting for its timelock.

types.name: RiskModel
docs: Zero-copy: at ~2.7 KiB a Borsh copy of this account does not fit in one
4 KiB SBF stack frame, so it is read and written in place.

fields.name: version
docs: Incremented on every change.

fields.name: corr
docs: Upper-triangle asset correlations, scaled 1e6, in [-1e6, 1e6].

fields.name: corr_stress_ppm
docs: Correlation stress delta, scaled 1e6.

fields.name: basis_decorr_ppm
docs: Decorrelation of offsetting same-asset legs on different venues, 1e6.

fields.name: scenario_kind
docs: `ch_math::risk::scenario_kind` per slot (0 = unused).

fields.name: scenarios
docs: Per-asset signed moves in bps; an unused slot is all zeros (no loss).

fields.name: oracle_feeds
docs: Pyth feed id per asset (`pyth` builds); all zeros = no feed, and
every price read for that asset fails closed.

fields.name: activation_eta_slot
docs: 0 when active immediately (timelock 0).

fields.name: venue_authority
docs: The key that must sign snapshot writes. In production builds this is
the PDA [b"clearinghouse"] of `venue_program_id`, so only that
program (via CPI) can sign.

fields.name: activation_eta_slot
docs: Slot from which a requested activation may be completed; 0 = none.
